shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,85p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 22 '"'^## (Navigation|Icons)'"' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Text && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && ls -a"

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Text && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'curl -L -s https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt && wc -c /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | head -25 && cat package.json && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -160 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -125 && rg -n 'peerDependencies|react|version' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json && rg -n 'brand|background|radius' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -35 && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'CSS|--gn-|--g-|renderFooter|logo|width' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -65 && sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -90 && rg -n '"'^#|File|Upload|Button|Checkbox|Switch|Select|TextInput'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt | head -50 && sed -n '130,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && rg -n 'export.*(Person|Shield|Bell|CircleQuestion|ArrowUpFrom|ArrowRightFrom|ChevronRight|Gear|Globe|Envelope|Check|Camera|CircleCheck|ArrowShape)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/icons').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html',t))\" && rg -o '.{0,50}(person|shield-check|bell|arrow-up-from-line|circle-question|gear|globe|camera|envelope|chevron-right).{0,80}' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | head -20 && rg -n 'controlProps|type:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -130 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -8"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts && rg -n 'onUpdate|aria-label' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && rg -n 'export.*(Person|ShieldCheck|Gear|Globe|Envelope|CircleInfo|ArrowRightFromSquare|CircleQuestion|Xmark|Moon|Sun)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && sed -n '535,575p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && rg -n 'size-expanded|expanded-width|--gn-aside-header-size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/*.css | head -15 && cat index.html"
